rca_of_issue: Root cause: React 19 in production Next.js builds uses a different internal event queue (fiber reconciler with concurrent mode). Native DOM events dispatched via JavaScript (dispatchEvent) OR Playwright's page.type() do not trigger React synthetic event handlers in this environment. The email state remains empty. Fix options: (1) Replace controlled input with uncontrolled + ref, (2) Remove disabled prop and rely on HTML5 form required validation, (3) Use a different button enable strategy not based on React state.
